notes: 4.7.0 shipped a wrong number, and the gate that was supposed to catch it caught it — one release late. The defect An add-on book's live value is an increment on an operating base, not a standalone claim about the share price. On PLTR the base is 7.96 and the book 14.27, summing to 22.23 against a price of 123. enumerateCandidates computed price / live_fair_value for every frame, so the panel said the PLTR book "requires 8.62x" (123 ÷ 14.27).
